role: Deep-dive PDF report sections for sleep (duration/efficiency, architecture, trends), training load (CTL/ATL/TSB, ACWR, yesterday TRIMP, VO2max) and recovery vitals (respiratory rate, SpO2, wrist temperature, RHR, combined pattern), with localized explanatory and interpretation text.
toplevel: File-scope private row builders (lines 368-558) produce DeepDiveMetric rows; no stored state.

flags.text: SpO2 copy hardcodes '−10 points' in two strings instead of reading RecoveryScoreConstants.Vitals.spo2Penalty as RecoveryScoreDetailView and ScoreBreakdownCopy do; a constant change would leave the PDF wrong.

units.does: Draws the 'Sleep — Complete Analysis' title then the duration, architecture and trends subsections, returning the new y.
Draws 'Duration & Efficiency' and one metric row each for total sleep, efficiency, time in bed and (if any) time awake.
Draws 'Sleep Architecture' with explanation and deep/REM/light rows; skipped when neither deep nor REM minutes exist.
Collects non-nil deep, REM and light sleep rows.
Deep sleep row: minutes and % of total sleep with explanation and interpretDeepSleep; nil without deep minutes.
REM row: minutes and % of total with explanation and interpretREMSleep; nil without REM minutes.
Draws 'Sleep Trends (N nights)' with the trend summary and average deep sleep when >2 nights analyzed.

branches.effect: returns after summary; else adds the average-deep line

units.does: Draws the 'Training Load — Complete Analysis' title and PMC, ACWR, yesterday and VO2max subsections.
Draws the PMC explanation and CTL/ATL/TSB rows.
Returns [CTL, ATL, TSB] rows.
CTL row with value (%.0f), 42-day EWMA explanation and interpretCTL.
ATL row with value, 7-day EWMA explanation and interpretATL(atl, ctl).
TSB row with signed value, explanation (+5…+25 peak, −10…−30 adaptive) and interpretTSB.
Draws the ACWR subsection with value, Gabbett/Impellizzeri explanation and interpretACWR when the ratio exists.
Draws 'Recent Training Context' with yesterday's TRIMP row when it is > 0.
Draws the estimated VO2max row (value, explanation, interpretVO2Max) when present.
Draws the 'Recovery Vitals' title, explanation, each available vitals row and the combined pattern; returns y+10.
Draws 'Combined Vitals Pattern' with assessVitalsPattern text when non-empty (after reserving 40 pt, which may start a new page even when nothing is drawn).
Collects non-nil respiratory, SpO2, wrist temperature (labelled via generator.wristTemperatureDeviationLabel) and RHR rows.
Respiratory rate row (br/min value, baseline-aware explanation and interpretation); nil without a rate.

Respiratory interpretation: without baseline ≤16 normal, ≤20 upper normal, else elevated; with baseline diff >2 elevated (lowers Vitals), >1 slightly above, else no concern — matching VitalsScoring's 1 br/min band and isRespiratoryElevated (>2).

flags.text: Without a baseline the PDF labels 17-20 br/min 'Upper normal' and <12 'Normal range', but the score's population path treats 12-18 as normal and deducts 15 points per br/min above 18 (20 br/min -> sub-score 70) and scores <12 as 90; the PDF row says nothing about a penalty the score applied.

units.does: Collects total sleep, efficiency, time in bed and (non-nil) time awake rows.
Total sleep row (formatted total) with NSF explanation and ≥7 h / ≥6 h / <6 h interpretation.
Sleep efficiency row: 'Not measured' with no interpretation when nil; else %.0f%% with ≥90/≥85/≥80/<80 interpretation.
Time-in-bed row with WASO/CBT-I explanation, no interpretation.
Time awake row with <30/<60/≥60 min interpretation; nil when awakeMinutes is 0.
Light sleep row: total − deep − REM minutes and % of total; nil when ≤0.

flags.text: When only one of deep/REM minutes is present, the missing stage is counted as 0 and its minutes are reported as Light Sleep, overstating the light-sleep minutes and percentage (the section is drawn whenever either stage exists).

units.does: Trend text: 'Average: <h m> at <eff> efficiency.' (or without efficiency) plus a trend sentence per SleepTrend case.
Yesterday's TRIMP row with <50/<150/<300/≥300 interpretation.
Respiratory explanation: population range plus, with a baseline, the baseline and signed deviation and the >2 br/min rule; otherwise the infection-signal caveat.

flags.text: Explanation states the normal adult sleep range is 12-20 breaths/min, while recovery scoring uses 12-18 br/min as its population normal (respiratoryRatePopulationMaxBPM = 18).

units.does: SpO2 row: average (and min when present) with explanation and ≥95 typical / <95 penalized interpretation; nil without SpO2.
Wrist temperature deviation row: value via the generator's unit-aware label, or '—' with 'No baseline yet' when a reading exists without baseline; nil when neither.

branches.cond: no deviation and baseline not lacking

branches.effect: 'No baseline yet' interpretation; else banded interpretation

units.does: Wrist temperature bands: >1.0 substantially elevated, >0.5 elevated, >0.3 mildly elevated, < −0.3 below baseline, else typical — matching the scoring bands (0.3/0.5/1.0).
Resting HR row with absolute-band interpretation (<50, <60, <70, <80, ≥80) each reminding that recovery reads it against baseline; nil without RHR.
